title: Enterprise Multimodal Video & Visual Asset Understanding, Keyframe Indexing & Search Architecture Selection

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Audio Transcript (`Whisper ASR`) Only (Zero Visual Frame Analysis)
tiers.architecture: Transcribing audio tracks only while ignoring silent screen shares, whiteboard diagrams, and physical safety/retail video events

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Uniform `1 FPS` Frame Extraction + Frontier VLM (`GPT-4o / Claude Vision`) on Every Frame
tiers.architecture: Extracting 3,600 frames per hour of video (`1.8M frames` per 500 hours) and calling a frontier VLM on every single frame

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Scene-Change Keyframes + `CLIP / SigLIP` Visual Embedding Only (No OCR or VLM Action Summary)
tiers.architecture: Embedding deduplicated keyframes with CLIP/SigLIP without OCR on presentation slides or VLM temporal action descriptions

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Scene-Change + Perceptual-Hash Deduplication (`94%` Frame Reduction) + `Whisper + OCR + SigLIP` + Selective `Qwen2.5-VL / Cloud Video AI`
tiers.architecture: PySceneDetect + pHash prunes `3,600 -> 180` keyframes/hr (`-95%` frames) + Parallel `Whisper ASR` + Slide `OCR` + `SigLIP` Embeddings + Selective VLM Captioning on High-Motion/Slide-Change Windows

scenarios.scenario: Eliminating the '$720,000/Month 1-FPS Frontier VLM Video Bill' via Scene-Change + pHash Deduplication
scenarios.question: An enterprise ingests 50,000 hours/month of recorded engineering town halls, training videos, and store/factory cameras; sampling at 1 FPS produces 180,000,000 frames/month
scenarios.model_answer: In enterprise meetings and surveillance videos, **95% of consecutive 1-FPS frames are static slides or unchanged backgrounds**! Run **Shot-Boundary Detection (`PySceneDetect / FFmpeg I-Frame`) + Perceptual Hash (`pHash`) Deduplication** on CPU to compress `3,600 frames/hr` down to **`180 unique keyframes/hr` (`-95.0%` frames)** before touching a GPU or VLM (`$920 / 1,000 hrs` vs `$14,400 / 1,000 hrs`, saving `$674K/mo`!)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 pays frontier VLM token rates on 3,600 redundant frames per hour ($720,000/mo for 50K hours).

scenarios.scenario: Searching Silent Screen-Share Slides, Architecture Diagrams & Code Demos in Recorded Meetings
scenarios.question: An engineer asks: 'Find the exact timestamp in last week's 2-hour architecture review where the speaker showed the Kafka partition latency table on their screen' (the speaker only said 'As you can see on this slide...')
scenarios.model_answer: Audio-only `Whisper` transcripts (`Tier 1`, `18.0%` visual recall) completely miss silent screen-shared tables! Tier 4 runs **Slide OCR + `SigLIP` Visual Embedding + Selective `Qwen2.5-VL-7B / Azure AI Content Understanding` Captioning** on every deduplicated slide-change keyframe, linking exact `[video_id, start_sec, end_sec]` timestamps (`96.8%` visual recall)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 indexes only spoken words ('As you can see here'), returning 0 results for text shown visually on slides.

scenarios.scenario: Temporal Action Understanding Across Multi-Second Video Clips (`8-Frame Window VLM` vs. Single Static Frame)
scenarios.question: In manufacturing SOP compliance or retail loss-prevention video, a single static keyframe cannot tell whether a worker put on safety goggles *before* or *after* starting the machine
scenarios.model_answer: Group motion-triggered keyframes into **8-frame temporal windows (`4–8 second` clips)** and pass the composite 2x4 frame grid (or native video token sequence) to **`Qwen2.5-VL / Gemini 1.5 Pro / TwelveLabs Marengo`**, capturing temporal ordering (`94.5%` temporal localization IoU)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 single-frame `CLIP` embeddings (`76.0%` IoU) are blind to temporal sequence ('before' vs 'after').

scenarios.scenario: Time-Aligned Tri-Modal Fusion (`Audio ASR + Visual OCR + VLM Scene Caption`) in Hybrid Vector Search
scenarios.question: How should audio transcripts, slide OCR text, and visual embeddings be aligned in the vector database so users can search by spoken words, on-screen text, or visual appearance?
scenarios.model_answer: Index video in **Scene-Aligned 15-to-30 Second Temporal Segments** where each segment fuses `[Whisper_Transcript + Keyframe_OCR + VLM_Action_Summary]` for hybrid `BM25 + Text Vector` search alongside a **`SigLIP` Multi-Vector Visual Index**—delivering `460ms` P95 search latency at `$46K/mo` TCO (`-93.6%` vs Tier 2)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Storing audio transcripts and video frames in unaligned tables breaks cross-modal queries where the user combines spoken context with visual objects.

perturbation_checks.check: 2-Hour Screen-Share Coding Demo Where Only 15 Lines of Code Change Every 3 Minutes
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 96.5% Recall (pHash + Diff-Region Cropping Sends Only Changed Screen Regions to OCR/VLM)

perturbation_checks.check: Privacy Redaction of Bystander Faces & License Plates Before Cloud VLM Indexing
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 100% Compliance (Lightweight Edge YOLOv8/YuNet Blurs Faces & Plates in <4ms/frame Before VLM)

key_findings: Tier 4 (Scene-Change + pHash Deduplication `-95% frames` + Tri-Modal `Whisper + OCR + SigLIP` + Selective 8-Frame VLM) achieves 96.8% visual event recall and 94.5% temporal localization IoU at $920 per 1,000 video hours ($46K/mo vs $720K/mo for 1-FPS frontier VLM, -93.6%).
Sampling enterprise videos at 1 FPS into a frontier VLM (Tier 2) wastes 95% of vision tokens on static slides and unchanged backgrounds.

Fusing Whisper ASR transcripts, slide/screen OCR, SigLIP visual embeddings, and 8-frame temporal VLM captions into time-aligned `[video_id, start_sec, end_sec]` segments enables sub-500ms multimodal video RAG.
